This guide shows you what to do when: You get fired (your employer is not happy with you) You get laid off (your employer has no work for you) You quit (you choose to leave) You change jobs This guide is only for employees, not freelancers.

title: Calculate your notice period
text: Your job has a notice period (Kündigungsfrist). It’s written in your work contract. If you quit, you must work until the end of your notice period. The notice period starts when your employer gets yourresignation letter. Your notice period can be very long: 3 months is normal for some jobs.8Some jobs have a 6-month notice period. To leave sooner, negotiate a shorter notice period with your employer.35 How the notice period works

title: Give your resignation letter
text: To quit your job, you must give a resignation letter (Kündigungsschreiben). Your resignation is only valid when your employer receives your resignation letter. That’s when yournotice periodstarts. How to write and send your resignation letter Your employer can’t force you to resign. Never write a resignation letter if you did not choose to resign.

title: See a doctor
text: If you quit for mental health reasons (burnout, depression, stress), get asick notefrom a doctor. This proves that you had a valid reason to quit.11If you don’t have a sick note, this is harder to prove. If you quit without a reason, you lose 3 months ofunemployment benefits.

section: If you get fired or laid off
text: If your employer does not need you, you can getlaid off. If your employer has financial problems, they can also put you onKurzarbeit. If your employer is not happy with your work, you can getfired. You can’t get fired without a good reason, except duringprobation period. You get written warnings before you get fired, except for very serious reasons.2

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Resist
text: During yourprobation period, you can be fired without a reason. After your probation period ends, your employer needs a valid reason to fire you. If you don’t agree with the reason, you have 3 weeks to resist with aKündigungsschutzklage.26These are often successful.1Get legal helpfor this.

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Finish your notice period
text: Your job has a notice period (Kündigungsfrist), even during yourprobation period. If you get laid off, you get paid until the end of the notice period. During your notice period, your employer can make you work, or send you ongarden leave. If you have unused vacation days, your employer usually forces you to go on vacation. If you get fired for misconduct, there might be no notice period.9 How the notice period works

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Negotiate severance pay
text: If you get laid off, ask for severance pay (Abfindung). Usually, you must sign a termination agreement (Abwicklungsvertrag) to get severance pay. In other words, your employer pays you to leave without suing them. There is no guaranteed severance pay. You must negotiate how much severance pay you get.22You usually get 0.5× yourgrossmonthly income for each year of employment.17For example, if you work 5 years for an employer, your severance pay could be 2.5 months of income. A labour lawyer can help you negotiate better severance pay, because they know how much money you can get. Find a labour lawyer Severance pay can affect yourunemployment benefits. If your severance pay is really high, you can lose 3 months of unemployment benefits.21Sometimes, it’s better to refuse severance pay and get unemployment benefits. If you are not sure, ask a labour lawyer. How unemployment benefits work If you are over 50 years old and plan to retire soon, you can ask forpension payments instead of severance pay. It might be a better deal for you.

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Do not sign an Auf­he­bungs­ver­trag
text: Your employer cansuggesta termination agreement (Aufhebungsvertrag).If you sign it, you don’t get fired; you agree to leave.This is not always a good idea. If you sign a termination agreement…15 You lose dismissal protection(Kündigungsschutz)You can’t sue your employer for firing you, because you agreed to leave. Your employer wants you to sign anAufhebungsvertragbecause it’s safer for them. You can negotiate better severance pay(Abfindung)Usually, severance pay depends on signing anAufhebungsvertrag. This is the biggest benefit for you. You don’t always need anAufhebungsvertrag. You might get more severance pay if you wait to get fired, then sue your employer.37 There is no minimumnotice periodYou can agree to leave sooner. This is good if you already found another job. If you leave early, you sometimes get lessunemployment benefits.38 You can lose 3 months ofunemployment benefitsIf youchooseto leave, you usually lose 3 months of unemployment benefits.20It depends on what’s in yourAufhebungsvertrag. –How unemployment benefits work When you sign anAufhebungsvertrag, you make a deal with your employer. You get more money, they get less problems. You can accept, refuse or negotiate this deal. Your employer can’t force you to sign anAufhebungsvertrag.16If you are not sure,get legal help.

title: Register as a job seeker
text: When you know that you will be unemployed, register as a job seeker at theAgentur für Arbeit. You must do this 3 months before your last day of work, or 3 days after you learn that you will be unemployed. If you wait too long, you get lessunemployment benefits. How to register as a job seeker

title: Tell the Aus­län­der­be­hör­de
text: If you have aresidence permit, always tell theAusländerbehördewhen you change or lose your job. Do not wait more than 2 weeks.10Permanent residentsdon’t need to do this. If you change employers, use theonline formto tell theAusländerbehörde.34You get a PDF confirmation. If you lose your job, use my letter generator to write the message. Use theAusländerbehörde’s contact formto send it to thecorrect department. Attach yourresignation letteror termination notice. TheAusländerbehördewill reply by email. It can take a few weeks. They might not reply at all.39 What happens to your residence permit

title: Register as unemployed
text: When you know your last day of work, register as unemployed at theAgentur für Arbeit. You must do this to getunemployment benefits. Do it in your last 3 months of work. How to register as unemployed

title: Tell your health insurance
text: When you are unemployed, you keep yourhealth insurance. You keep the same coverage, but the price will change.6 What happens to your health insurance

title: Get a letter of reference
text: A letter of reference (Arbeitszeugnis) is a proof of the work you did for your employer. It can help yourjob search. Your next employer can ask for it.27 Your employer is required to give you a letter of reference.13Ask for it in yourresignation letter. Apprentices, working students, temporary workers andminijobberscan also demand a letter of reference. The letter must clearly explain the type of work you did, and for how long. Your employer must give you a paper version, not an electronic version. It must not have information about your health, your salary, your other jobs, your union membership, or your political affiliations. Your employer needs your explicit permission to mention why you quit or got fired.14 If you worked for more than 6 weeks, you can demand a qualified reference (qualifiziertes Arbeitszeugnis). It includes an evaluation of your performance, and the reason you left the company.

title: Get an Ar­beits­be­schei­ni­gung
text: Before you getunemployment benefits, your employer must send yourArbeitsbescheinigungto theAgentur für Arbeit.12Some employers take a long time to do this. How to get your Arbeitsbescheinigung

title: Get an Ur­laubs­be­schei­ni­gung
text: A vacation certificate (Urlaubsbescheinigung) shows how many unused vacation days you have. It tells your next employer how many vacation days you should get this year.30 Your employer must give you anUrlaubsbescheinigungif you ask for it.29Ask for it in yourresignation letter. What happens to your vacation days

title: Get all other documents
text: Your employer will give you these documents after your last paycheck:23 Salary taxstatement (Lohnsteuerbescheinigung) Last pay slip (GehaltsabrechnungorLohnabrechnung). You need these documents to apply forunemployment benefits, and to make atax declaration.

title: Get coaching or training
text: If you get unemployment benefits, you can get free professional training, coaching and language lessons. TheAgentur für Arbeitpays for it with aBildungsgutscheinor anAVGSvoucher. Ask about it during your unemployment benefits appointment at theAgentur für Arbeit. Your case worker will decide if you can get free training.28

title: Find a new job
text: How to find a job You can also start your own business and become self-employed. TheAgentur für Arbeitcan help you with free training and extra money (Gründungszuschuss). You might need a differentresidence permitfor this. How to start a business

title: Make a tax declaration
text: At the end of the year, make a tax declaration (Steuererklärung). Your job search expenses aretax-deductible. –More information. If you getunemployment benefits, youmustmake a tax declaration. If you don’t get unemployment benefits, you should still make a tax declaration. If you were unemployed for a few months, you probably paid too much taxes. Make a tax declaration to get some money back. German tax software English-speaking tax advisors in Berlin

title: Ask for a pension refund
text: When you work in Germany, you pay 9.3% of your salary forpension insurance. If youleave Germany, you can get that money back. How to get a pension payments refund

section: What happens to your residence permit
text: Alwaystell theAusländerbehördewhen you change or lose your job. In Berlin, they usually give you 6 to 12 months tofind another job.5 If you can’t find a jobafter 6 to 12 months, your residence permit expires, and you mustleave Germany. To stay longer, you can geta different residence permit.25You can apply for anopportunity cardand get an extra 12 months to find a job.32 When you find a job, you might need theAusländerbehörde’s permission to start your new job. It depends on yourresidence permit.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Blue Card
text: Check yourZusatzblatt.It tells you what you can do. In the first 12 monthswith a Blue Card, your new job must fulfil theBlue Card requirements.31You musttell theAusländerbehördethat you have a new job.4You can start working immediately. TheAusländerbehördehas 30 days to stop you. After 12 monthsof employment with a Blue Card, you can get any kind of job. There is no minimum salary requirement, but you can’t make less than€13.90per hour. You can start working immediately.33You shouldtell theAusländerbehördethat you have a new job, but they can’t really stop you.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Opportunity card
text: The opportunity card lets you work 20 hours per week for any employer.40To work full time, you must apply for a residence permit like awork visaor aBlue Card. You must wait for your residence permit before you work full time. It takes3 to 6 monthsto get a residence permit. Residence permits to work in Germany

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Job seeker visa
text: Check yourZusatzblatt.It tells you if you can work with your job seeker visa. If not, you need another residence permit to start working. It takes3 to 6 monthsto get a residence permit. Residence permits to work in Germany

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Family reunion visa
text: Yourfamily reunion visais not tied to your job. You can change jobs without permission from theAusländerbehörde. If you lose your job, nothing happens to your residence permit. Your spouse and children’s family reunion visas are tied to your residence permit. If you can stay in Germany, they can stay in Germany. If you lose your residence permit, they usually lose their family reunion visa too.36 If your spouse has a family reunion visa and you lose your job, you can switch residence permits. You get a family reunion visa, and your spouse gets another residence permit. If you change jobs, you don’t need to update your spouse and children’s family reunion visas.3

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Other residence permits
text: Check yourZusatzblatt.If it says “Beschäftigung erlaubt” or “Erwerbstätigkeit erlaubt”, you can start a new job immediately. You don’t need permission from theAusländerbehörde. Usually, you need theAusländerbehörde’s permission to change jobs. You must apply for a new residence permit before you start working. It takes3 to 6 monthsto get a residence permit. After 2 to 3 years in Germany, they might allow you to take any job, in any field, for any salary.7 Alwaystell theAusländerbehördeabout your new job, even if you don’t need their permission to change jobs.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Citizenship or permanent residence
text: If you are aEU citizenor aGermanpermanent resident, nothing happens. You don’t need to a job to live in Germany. You don’t need permission to change jobs. Yourpermanent residenceor citizenship application might be delayed until youfind another joband finish yourprobation period.24 How to apply for permanent residence

section: What happens to your health insurance
text: When you lose your job, you stay insured. The coverage stays the same, but the price changes. Health insurance when unemployed

section: What happens to your pay and bonuses
text: You get paid until the end of yournotice period, until your last day of work. Your employer must pay your full salary, even if you have no work to do.19 After your last day of work, you might get severance pay orunemployment benefits. This gives you financial support while youfind another job. If your employer gives performance bonuses, you should get that bonus, even if you leave the company.18Your bonus can be prorated. For example, if you should get a yearly performance bonus, but you leave in September, you should get 75% of the promised bonus. Bonuses are usually paid at the start of the next year. If you don’t get your bonus,talk to a lawyer.

section: What happens to your unused vacation days
text: Usually, your employer forces you use all your vacation days before the end of yournotice period. You still get paid while on vacation. After you use all your vacation days, your employer might send you ongarden leave. Vacation days when you change jobs During yournotice period, you can still take sick days. You still get paid while on sick leave. Sick leave during your notice period

If you need help, hire an employment lawyer (Anwalt für Arbeitsrecht). In Germany, it’s normal to hire a lawyer. It’s not an aggressive move.
